scientific_integrity: Cauchy and zonotope determinant formulas and the earlier six-normal twist and original-volume classification are credited as inputs; the new theorem is the sharp projection-body volume and affine quotient. All-parameter claims follow from a symbolic proof. No external independent verification has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Six distinct equal-weight spherical 2-design normals in R^3 and equal facet areas only; historical priority of an equivalent older zonotope formula remains provisional.
title: Sharp projection-body volume and reversed volume order for six-normal spherical designs
